flows.summary: A maintainer lists every entry point the target app exposes, so independent mapping passes have a shared join key.

steps.name: User runs `flowmap inventory` to scan the repo's adapters and write the entry-point list
steps.notes: Adapter per framework (fastapi, rails, nextjs, cli) is picked from flowmap.toml or auto-detected.

flows.summary: A maintainer prepares briefs for independent mapping agents and checks each pass's citations and coverage.

steps.name: User generates a pass brief for one run id and method
steps.notes: Fills flowmap/RUN_SPEC.md with method, stack and vocabulary text.

steps.name: User verifies a finished pass: every anchor exists and every inventory entry point is placed
steps.notes: Read-only; exit code 1 on any bad citation or missing entry point.

flows.summary: A maintainer merges several independent passes into one consensus map and a list of disagreements to review.

steps.name: User reconciles the passes by vote into map.json, MAP.md and QUESTIONS.md
steps.notes: Also reads docs/flowmap/decisions.json (human pins) and test dirs from flowmap.toml.

flows.summary: A maintainer renders the consensus map as Mermaid diagrams and an interactive HTML atlas.

steps.name: User generates Mermaid diagrams at system, flow and step zoom
User builds the interactive atlas page, optionally painting a PR's reach onto it
steps.notes: The page is the only thing a person interacts with; it is generated from atlas.template.html by atlas.build.

flows.summary: A reviewer sees where a code change lands on the flow map and which endpoints can reach changed code.

steps.name: Reviewer runs the lens on a base..head diff to see touched steps, reach and off-map code
steps.notes: Prints markdown to stdout; no file written.

steps.name: Reviewer asks which entry points and flows can reach a given symbol
steps.notes: Only the `impact` subcommand is useful; with no args it prints graph size.

observations: flowmap/bin/flowmap dispatches by runpy, so every command is a `__main__` block with business logic inline (flowmap/inventory.py:__main__, flowmap/diagrams.py:__main__) while others delegate to main(); inconsistent shape.
flowmap/lens.py:main is a ~200-line function mixing diff parsing, map matching, call-graph reach and markdown rendering.
flowmap/atlas.py:overlay duplicates the changed/new symbol computation from flowmap/lens.py:main instead of sharing it.
flowmap/reconcile.py:main is very large and writes map.json, MAP.md and QUESTIONS.md in one pass (write_map_md, write_questions_md).
flowmap/config.py:load is cached and also auto-detects entries (detect_entries), so a read of config can scan the filesystem with glob.
flowmap/brief.py:main reads flowmap/RUN_SPEC.md and drops the first lines by split, so the template header layout is load-bearing.

Commands lens, callgraph, diagrams and atlas require docs/flowmap/map.json (from reconcile) at import time (flowmap/lens.py MAP, flowmap/callgraph.py:endpoint_flows), so ordering between commands is implicit.
